info.title: Mesakem API
info.description: Your Mesakem meetings, transcripts, summaries, tasks, upcoming calendar meetings and recordings; on paid plans also writes: send and schedule the bot, notetaker automation, tasks, uploads, meeting rename/delete and public links. Use webhooks rather than polling; if you must poll, use updated_since and If-None-Match, at most every 5 minutes.
info.x-he-description: הפגישות, התמלולים, הסיכומים, המשימות, הפגישות הקרובות וההקלטות שלכם במסכם; בתוכניות בתשלום גם כתיבה: שליחה ותזמון של הבוט, הצטרפות אוטומטית, משימות, העלאות, שינוי שם ומחיקה של פגישות וקישורים ציבוריים. העדיפו webhooks על פני משיכה חוזרת; אם חייבים, השתמשו ב-updated_since וב-If-None-Match, לכל היותר פעם ב-5 דקות.

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 apps registered with Mesakem: authorization code with PKCE (S256), refresh tokens rotate on every use. Access tokens (mso_at_…) are sent as Authorization: Bearer.

meeting_id.description: meeting_bot_already_active: the meeting that already has the bot (null when it is not in this work area).

reason.description: Writes: the stable reason of a refusal (e.g. free_trial_exhausted, calendar_event_control_locked).

upgrade_url.description: plan_required on a write: where to upgrade.

organization.description: Organization keys only: the key's organization (user and workspace are null).

participants.description: Present on GET /meetings/{id}, and on lists with expand=participants (≤ 50 per meeting).

Participants.description: Attendance and talk time follow the dashboard rule: only the meeting creator, only inside the Recall artifacts rollout.

Summary.description: An edited summary keeps its edited body; its structured fields are null and structured_stale is true.

content.description: A string; JSON for format=json; base64 for format=docx.

anyOf.description: Valid for 5 minutes; stops working as soon as the key is revoked.

sources.description: Only meetings from these sources (the meeting `source` field).

room_ids.description: Only meetings in, and events of, these rooms.

secret_hint.description: Last 4 characters of the signing secret.

anyOf.description: While set, deliveries carry the previous secret's signature too.

secret.description: whsec_… — returned ONLY by create and rotate-secret. Store it; it is never shown again.

event_id.description: The webhook-id header value; stable across retries and redeliveries.

url.description: https only, port 443 or 8443, a public host.

signature_format.description: `simple_hmac` also sends the `X-Webhook-Signature` header, for receivers that cannot verify Standard Webhooks.

enabled.description: true re-enables an endpoint disabled after failures and resets its failure count.

WebhookEnvelope.description: What Mesakem POSTs to your endpoint.

data.description: Thin: ids, status and counts. Fetch details with the API (data.links.api).

allowed.description: False when the work area's administrator turned calendar auto-join off; then only MANUAL can be set.

upload.description: POST /uploads only: PUT the file here, with exactly these headers, before expires_at.

meeting_count.description: Meetings in the room that you can read (GET /meetings/{id} returns them).

meetings.description: expand=meetings: newest added first, at most items_limit.

decision_log.description: The decisions already stored on each readable meeting's summary (no AI involved).

analyses.description: Analyses already made in the dashboard, as stored. The API never creates one; null when none exists.

anyOf.description: The meeting this call produced, when GET /meetings/{id} returns it.

CallList.description: A page can hold fewer than limit calls; follow next_cursor.

anyOf.description: Valid for 5 minutes; stops working as soon as the key or app is revoked.

outcome.description: POST only. existing: the same name and instructions already existed (200).

A meeting that already has a Mesakem bot answers 409 meeting_bot_already_active with that meeting's meeting_id. Send an Idempotency-Key so a retry never sends a second bot.
